# Iolit

> Your AI subscription should pay you back.

Iolit is an open-source agent that captures AI coding sessions from Claude, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot. You pick a share tier before anything leaves. One audited network call.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL iolit.dev/install | sh
```

## How it works

1. Install: a tiny agent for macOS or Linux, silent in the background.
2. Pick a tier: pulse is loop stats, trace adds redacted tool args and results, raw also includes prompts. You choose every batch.
3. Earn: approve the preview. More you share, more you get paid.

## Share tiers

- pulse: structured loop stats only. No prompts, no tool args, no paths.
- trace: pulse plus redacted tool args and results. Secrets stripped. Paths scrubbed.
- raw: also includes prompt, reply, and thinking previews. Type YES to confirm.

## Privacy

- The client is MIT-licensed and open source: https://github.com/Emad-log/iolit-client
- Pulse never sends prompts or code
- Secrets stripped on every tier
- No keystroke logging or screenshots
- Pause or delete anytime
- One network call, CI-enforced: `scripts/check-network.js` fails the build if more than one call site exists

## Repos
